title: Bank Deposit Transfer-Size Credit on Incorrect-Amount Make-Good Credits
content:
The make-good credit for a Bank Deposit incorrect amount includes a transfer-size credit that follows what the customer paid on the transfer: the principal collected plus the fees collected.

## What is counted

- **Principal collected:** the total of the funds-received entries on the transfer's ledger.
- **Fees collected:** the total of every fee charge on the transfer's ledger, whatever its kind (transfer fee, card funding fee, OUR surcharge, resend fee, recall fee).

## Clause

A total at or above 1000 US dollars earns a transfer-size credit of 2.00 US dollars; a total at or above 500 US dollars but below 1000 US dollars earns 1.00 US dollar; any smaller total earns no transfer-size credit.

| Principal collected plus fees collected (USD) | Transfer-size credit |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 or more | 2.00 |
| 500.00 up to 999.99 | 1.00 |
| below 500.00 | none |

## Cases on both sides (hypothetical)

| Principal collected | Fees collected | Total | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 997.01 | 2.99 | 1000.00 | 2.00 |
| 996.00 | 2.99 | 998.99 | 1.00 |
| 497.01 | 2.99 | 500.00 | 1.00 |
| 495.00 | 3.99 | 498.99 | none |

The first row shows why the fees matter: the principal alone is below 1000.00, but principal and fees together reach it.
